title: Otter.ai Public API
snippet:
Plan required
This content is available for the **Otter Enterprise** plan and may require admin permissions.
Otter.ai’s Public API provides programmatic access to retrieve channels, conversations, transcripts, audio, action items, insights, outlines, and workspace details from your Otter account.
**Getting Started:** Otter's Public API is available for all Enterprise workspaces. If you do not see this feature for your workspace, contact your Otter account manager.

All API requests require authentication using Bearer token authentication. Follow the steps below to create your **API key.**
1. Go to [**Integrations → Developer**](https://otter.ai/setting/developer).
![](/hc/article_attachments/44608393062679)
2. Click **Create key.**

Enterprise plan users are currently limited to 10 requests / second. If you exceed your rate limit, you'll receive a `429 Too Many Requests` response.

title: Partner Hub
snippet:
Partner Hub is Otter's new workspace for partners who build integrations with Otter's APIs. It's where you set up your integration, get the credentials to connect your systems to Otter, and test everything in a safe sandbox before you go live.
With Partner Hub, you're able to:
- Create an application for your integration and work in its sandbox workspace
- Get and manage the API credentials that connect your systems to Otter
- Set up webhooks so your systems are notified when events happen
- Test against stores that Otter provisions for you
- Review your requests, responses, and delivery results in logs, without needing to submit a support ticket
- See configuration changes made by your team in one place

![disclaimer-notification.svg](/hc/article_attachments/57116393443347)When you're ready to go live, certification, billing, and production access are handled with your Otter contact. Partner Hub doesn't activate production on its own at this stage.

title: Integrated Partner Process
snippet:
## Step 1. Sign up to become an Integrated Partner
Sign up to become an Otter integrated partner via our [form](https://tryotter.com/become-a-partner).
After signing up, you will be contacted by our partnerships team for an exploratory chat to learn more about your technology and next steps on the integration building process.
## Step 2. Get your API key and staging environment
After your initial contact with our partnerships team, our technical team will provide you access to our developer portal where you will have access to your API key and staging environment.
Learn more about our API Documentation [here](https://developer-guides-staging.tryotter.com/docs/).

Otter Technical Integration Managers will share with your technical team in the early stages of the building process a document with the event logs that will need to be successfully completed for your integration certification process. The features required will vary depending on the type of integration you are building with Otter (Orders, POS or Delivery).
